answer_1.quote: In this work, we push the frontier using the latter approach to improve on the ability of LLMs to perform machine translation of low-resource languages by utilizing available linguistic reference materials.

answer_2.quote: We compute all evaluation metrics using SacreBLEU and we also report statistical significance using paired bootstrap resampling... The main paper uses chrF++ scores to evaluate translations... We also calculate BLEU scores for all of our experiments...
